zero=next(x for x in obs if (x.chapter,x.post,x.meaning)==('4400','2','etter_belop'));assert type(zero.amount_kr)==int and zero.amount_kr==0
assert [a.frame_kr for a in whole.basis.authorizations if a.roman=='IV']==[16300000]
assert not any('1533/45' in b.accounts for b in whole.basis.branches)

assert pairs[0]['fields']==3 and pairs[1]['fields']==111
originals=[];o2=o2read(old.basis.o2b_json)
for prefix,sources in [('t1/',old.basis.sources),('o2b/',o2.basis.sources),('',whole.basis.sources)]:
 for s in sources:

  raw=base64.b64decode(s.content_base64,validate=True);name=prefix+s.name;assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==s.sha256 and len(raw)==s.byte_count
  for directory in (r/'.local/fresh-exports/originaler',r/'.local/cli-originals'):assert (directory/name).read_bytes()==raw
  originals.append({'path':name,'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':s.sha256,'both_exports_identical':True})
assert len(originals)==25
book=load_workbook(r/'.local/cli-zero.xlsx');c=book['Forløp']['G4'];assert c.value==0 and c.data_type=='n';book.close()
